title: Pelorsun Blade
summary: +1 rapier adds Radiant damage and grants Advantage against undead.

fields.Weapon: Martial one-handed finesse, 5-ft melee. 1d8 + 1 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity, plus 1d4 Radiant on hit. +1 to attacks.
fields.Undead Bane: Advantage on this weapon’s attacks against undead. The pinned passive reports the live effect extends to all attack rolls against undead.
fields.Flourish: Bonus Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Nonlethal 1d4 Bludgeoning. Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 or Off Balance for 2 turns. Off Balance gives attackers Advantage and imposes Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks. Damage or Help clears it.
fields.Piercing Strike: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Deal weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or Gaping Wounds for 2 turns, adding 2 Piercing damage to subsequent hits. Undead and constructs are immune. Healing clears Gaping Wounds. In Honour Mode the +2 adopts the original damage type and applies to any damage source.
fields.Weakening Strike: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Nonlethal attack for 1d4 plus the attack ability modifier of the weapon’s damage type. Strength save against weapon-action DC +2 or Weak Grip for 2 turns. Creatures without weapons are immune. Weak Grip imposes Disadvantage on attack rolls and Strength saves. An ally can clear it with Help.
fields.Acquisition: Cazador’s Dungeon. DC 15 Perception reveals the dirt mound with a trapped rosewood casket.
fields.Base value: 960 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
